```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  ai-moderator:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
